Thanks to a graft from a hardy deep-sea invertebrate in your stomach, you can ingest food and water that would be toxic to others. You gain a +2 item bonus to Fortitude saving throws against ingested [diseases](/Traits.aspx?ID=578) and [poisons](/Traits.aspx?ID=669).
